messages:
maya: Staging hotfix 3.4.2 ready for expedited approval. Root cause: kv-cache memory leak on long-running embeddings requests -> intermittent 503s. Need ops + SRE signoff to skip the 30m canary and roll to staging. Details and rollback below.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks complete.
- CI: pass
- e2e (limited): pass
- perf smoke: mem usage down ~40% in repro
- security scan: no new findings

Deploy command:
```
./deploy --env=staging --image=redwood/api:3.4.2-hotfix-kvcache
```

Notes: rollback image available: redwood/api:3.4.1-rc2

alex: Can we confirm rollback fast path? Who will run rollback? Also what's the traffic shift plan?

maya: Rollback plan: immediate image re-pin and traffic shift to previous stable. Steps (runbook):
1) pin canary to 3.4.1-rc2
2) scale up replicas of previous version
3) shift traffic 100% to old version
Manual estimated time: 5-10m.
Rollback command example:
```
kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:3.4.1-rc2 -n staging
```
I'll be online to execute if needed.

jun: I'll own SRE side for alerts and monitoring. I'll enable a temporary pager and watch SLOs. Grafana quicklink: https://grafana.internal/r/alerts/kvcache-503
Planned alert: rate(503) > 0.3% for 2m -> pager. Also will toggle a concurrency circuit-breaker on embeddings route if noise increases.

ops_lead: Need runbook link + explicit rollback owner before I can approve skipping the full canary. Post runbook snippet here.

maya: Runbook posted: https://confluence.internal/ops/runbooks/kvcache-hotfix (updated with steps and owners: maya + jun). Snippet:
```
1. Verify canary pods healthy
2. Roll canary to 50% over 5m
3. Monitor 503 and p95 latency
4. If 503 > 0.3% or p95 > 500ms -> rollback
```

sre-oncall: I approve expedited canary-skip to straight staging ramp if the first 5m smoke shows no regressions. I'll keep pager ready. :white_check_mark:

dan: Quick Q — do we need net/change-window signoff? This touches peered clusters for egress.

maya: No infra/network changes — image swap only in staging cluster. Net was notified earlier in the incident thread; no blocking comments.

ops_lead: Conditional approved: runbook posted + Jun on alerts. Proceed. :rocket:

maya: Starting deploy to staging now — targeting 50% traffic for 5m then ramp. deploy-bot: please execute.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: job id dpl-5943
- canary pods up: 3/3
- image: redwood/api:3.4.2-hotfix-kvcache
- health checks: passing

maya: First 3m metrics look good. 503 rate down to 0.02%. Memory usage normalized. Holding for remaining 2m then will ramp to 100%.

jun: All green from SRE dashboards, no pager noise. Approving ramp to 100%.

maya: Ramping to 100%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift completed to 100% for staging.
- job id dpl-5943
- timestamp: 1718254590

maya: Closing thread — hotfix accepted in staging. Planning prod rollout in the 02:00 UTC change window pending same approvals; will open separate prod thread.
